data.one_liner: A reorderable grid view widget for Flutter supporting drag-and-drop reordering.
data.what_it_does: Provides reorderable grid and sliver grid views similar to the official ReorderableListView. Allows users to drag and drop items to change their order in a grid layout with support for headers, footers, and custom drag widgets.
use_when: You need a grid layout where users can reorder items via drag and drop
You want support for header and footer items inside a reorderable grid
avoid_when: You have extremely long lists where placeholderBuilder encounters bugs
You require robust drag scope constraints specifically inside ReorderableSliverGridView
strengths: Easy migration for developers familiar with ReorderableListView
Supports builder and count constructors along with sliver variants
Provides customization options for drag widgets and scroll speed
weaknesses: Known issue with placeholderBuilder when lists are very long
Dragging out of scope behaves differently in ReorderableSliverGridView
